baseline_note: output_0, output_3 and output_4 do not carry the NVTE kernel output. All three are produced by cuBLASLt kernels whose accumulation is less accurate than the NPU's on some shapes (REPORT atk 3#26 for the grad slots; the last two red all_linear cases -- fp16 id73/id137 -- for output_0, where NVTE scores 0.9616/0.9851 against exact fp64 while the NPU scores 1.0000), so the golden holds exact fp64 references instead. output_0's reference is x @ W^T with the bias added only when the module applies it (bias_enabled and not return_bias). Judging NVTE against this tree fails exactly those slots by design. The device under test is never substituted; see tests/atk/module/_exact_reference.py.
